title: Access counter increment path
statement: For either access mode, any bit-string input $y$ and natural numbers $k,p$ satisfying $k+1\le |y|+1$ and $p+1\le |y|+1$ admit an access path from the configuration in the first bump state, with four work tapes containing the binary representations of $0,0,k,p$ and all work heads at position $0$, to the configuration in the initial scan state with work tapes containing the binary representations of $0,0,k+1,p+1$ and all work heads at position $0$.
